query: What features can be extracted from a company's business description to predict its regional cluster?

per_column.name: industry_vertical
per_column.rationale: A well-distributed categorical axis directly derivable from the description text; strong grouping variable for predicting regional cluster. Samples map soundly (5AM->VC, 280 Group->enterprise_software is defensible).

per_column.name: company_type
per_column.rationale: Useful maturity/type axis with good variety. However values like 'large_enterprise_public' for 23andMe are not supported by the terse description text alone; stage/public-status is an invented specific not present in source, lowering groundedness.

per_column.name: cloud_infra_signal
per_column.rationale: Dominated by 'not_present' (153 of ~199), so near-constant and offers limited analytical leverage, though when present it is grounded in text and adds a modest signal.

per_column.name: target_market_segment
per_column.rationale: Reasonable B2B/B2C axis useful for clustering. Somewhat skewed to enterprise_b2b; VC firms labeled enterprise_b2b is a stretch but defensible. Mostly sound readings.

per_column.name: deployment_model
per_column.rationale: Good distinguishing axis (SaaS vs hardware vs services). But 'saas_cloud_delivered' for 23andMe is inferred beyond the description, which does not mention delivery model; some confident specifics where text is silent.

per_column.name: business_model_type
per_column.rationale: Useful monetization/model axis, though 'product_led_growth' is heavily dominant and partially overlaps deployment/type. Sample mappings are mostly reasonable readings of the text.

judge.rationale: The added columns provide multiple genuine categorical axes (vertical, type, market, deployment, business model) that give real leverage for modeling regional cluster from business descriptions. Main weakness is groundedness: several columns (company_type, deployment_model) assert specifics like public-company status or SaaS delivery that terse descriptions do not support, indicating some inference beyond the source. cloud_infra_signal is near-constant and adds little. Overall useful and mostly grounded with localized hallucination risk.
